title: Erdős-Straus Diophantine Decomposition
conjecture_statement: For every integer n >= 2, 4/n = 1/x + 1/y + 1/z has positive integer solutions.
bounded_statement: Find exact positive integer solutions (x, y, z) for nominated prime instances n in {1009, 10007, 100003} with search bound M <= 10^9.

bounds.rule: max(x, y, z) <= 10^9, strictly enforced; out-of-bound finalists rejected, never certified

frozen_method: P29 GPU modular filtering with bounds_strict=true plus P31 dual exact CPU gates; no algorithm change during scoring

baseline.description: Deterministic CPU enumeration of the same (x, y) space in the same order, same checkers and bounds, time-boxed to the GPU wall-clock per instance.

coverage: Budget-limited exploration (x in [n//4+1, n//4+50], y windows <= 500000 per x step); NOT exhaustive. A failed finite search is not a counterexample.
literature_status: Conjecture OPEN in general as of 2026. Nominated prime instances are long-studied benchmarks, not newly open conjectures.
novelty_plan: Compare each certified instance against the repo catalogue (P29/P31 certificates) and cited parametric families; no exhaustive external catalogue lookup. Without positive novelty evidence the weaker rediscovery label is retained.
reproduction: Independent dual-checker CPU reproduction; operator is self-repetition, disclosed as not independent authorship.
